info.title: GovCon Post-Award Debriefing, FAR 15.506 Q&A & GAO Bid-Protest Analyzer API
info.description: Transforms Agency Unsuccessful Offeror Notices, FAR 15.506 / DFARS 215.506-70 Post-Award Debriefing slides, Source Selection Decision Documents (SSDDs), and RFP Section M criteria into strategic Contracting Officer debriefing questions, a GAO / COFC Bid-Protest Viability Scorecard (or Winning Awardee Intervenor Defense Brief), FASA Task-Order jurisdictional checks (FAR 16.505(a)(10)), and a strict CICA (31 U.S.C. 3553) automatic-stay deadline schedule.

post.operationId: Analyze Post-Award Debriefing, FAR 15.506 Questions & GAO Bid-Protest Merits
post.summary: Generate FAR 15.506 Enhanced Debriefing Questions, GAO Bid-Protest Viability Scorecard & CICA Stay Deadlines
post.description: Analyzes Agency Award Notices, FAR 15.506 / DFARS 215.506-70 Debriefing letters, and RFP Section M evaluation criteria to produce strategic debriefing questions, GAO/COFC bid-protest grounds (Unstated Evaluation Criteria, Disparate Treatment, Flawed Best-Value Tradeoff, Cost Realism Errors) or Winning Awardee Intervenor defenses, and strict CICA automatic-stay timelines.

example.award_notice_or_debrief_text: UNSUCCESSFUL OFFEROR NOTICE & POST-AWARD DEBRIEFING SUMMARY — Solicitation FA8732-26-R-0041 (USAF Cloud & Zero-Trust DevSecOps Modernization): Award made to Incumbent Defense Corp at $28.4M (Technical: Outstanding, Past Performance: Substantial Confidence). Your Proposal (Apex Cyber Federal, $22.9M — $5.5M lower price) received Technical: Acceptable (1 Weakness assigned under Subfactor 1B for not proposing an pre-existing ऑन-prem SCIF lab in Dayton, OH) and Past Performance: Satisfactory Confidence.
example.rfp_section_m_and_bidder_context: Section M.2 Evaluation Criteria: Best-Value Tradeoff (Technical Approach > Past Performance > Cost/Price). Section C/L/M never required an on-prem Dayton SCIF lab (PWS 3.1 explicitly stated 100% remote AWS GovCloud IL5 delivery with quarterly TDY travel). Offeror submitted 3 USAF Prime IL5 Cloud DevSecOps contracts rated Exceptional in CPARS.

award_notice_or_debrief_text.description: Raw text from the Agency Unsuccessful Offeror Notice, Post-Award Debriefing letter/slides, Source Selection Decision Document (SSDD) excerpt, or competitor protest allegations.

rfp_section_m_and_bidder_context.description: RFP Section L/M evaluation criteria, weighting hierarchy (Best-Value Tradeoff vs. LPTA), and summary of the bidder's submitted ratings, evaluated price, and proposal strengths/weaknesses.
